r: Responsible for the development of engineering design submissions (2D & 3D) in order to ensure all designs meet the functional, economic, environmental, technical and safety requirements of the project and recommend alternatives/remedial solutions if necessary
Lead design reviews to ensure products/equipment/installations meet the client’s specifications and requirements and designs are aligned with contractual terms and conditions

Conduct test fits/stress analysis for all design specifications and evaluate potential design options and project configurations to ensure practicality and validity of engineering designs to support the execution of day to day operations / projects

Responsible for analysing engineering design issues that arise during the preliminary design phase, propose solutions and where necessary and redesign engineering designs to comply with change requests / specification amendments / modifications etc, whilst ensuring compliance with Fives policies and procedures and industry and regulatory standards

Responsible for the design of jigs, welding fixtures and special purpose machines (SPM) to meet production/operational requirements and ensure all designs are compliant with industry standards and specifications
Act as the point of contact for all design / drawing amendments, modifications, approvals ensuring all design elements meet customer specifications and contractual terms and conditions

Prepare the bill of materials from drawings, designs and specifications to ensure all material requirements are itemized and categorized for production purposes, and submit the bill of materials to initiate purchase requests to ensure on time delivery to fulfil project requirements

Responsible for ensuring the timely preparation and submission of production orders, conducting review of material selection and certification requirements whilst ensuring compliance with Company policies and procedures, and industry standards

Contribute to the preparation and response to RFQ’s/quotations, review and submit technical requirements and specifications, participate in subcontractor selection against agreed criteria, and support the bidding process as per business requirements
Review and approve all design processes and activities to ensure sub-contractors / customers comply with applicable project requirements and monitor adherence to technical / design specifications

Support the Engineering Manager to review projects/production requirements and monitor expenditure related to bill of materials, and ensure the bill of materials is reconciled in a timely manner as per Company policies and procedures

Participate in technical investigations, trouble shooting and detailed fault finding for recurring and/or serious problems related to design and manufacturing processes and recommend corrective and preventative actions to ensure delivery of operational requirements

Responsible for the preparation and delivery of all manuals and documents i.e installation manual, spare parts manual, maintenance manual etc related to installation & commissioning, preventative and maintenance requirements and general operations as per Company policies and procedures

Responsible for ensuring all design/drawing records are kept fully up to date on an "As-built" basis with all additions/modifications recorded as per Company policies and procedures and maintain a robust document control system for ease of reference and retrieval
Participate in internal /external audits as required and ensure all audit requirements are conducted and delivered as per Company policies and procedures and operational requirements
Ensure compliance with all relevant (internal and external) regulations including HSEQ requirements using Company policies and procedures as appropriate

d: We are looking for an experienced Project Manager – 380kV Substation to manage the complete execution of high-voltage substation projects. The role will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering projects in line with SEC requirements, contractual obligations, safety standards, quality requirements, budget, and schedule.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience managing 380kV GIS/AIS Substation projects for an EPC contractor, with hands-on exposure to engineering coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and project handover.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering / Power Engineering .
Minimum 12–15 years of overall experience in high-voltage substation projects.
Previous experience working with an EPC contractor is highly preferred.
Experience managing projects for Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) is highly preferred.
Saudi Council of Engineers registration is preferred for candidates working in Saudi Arabia.
Strong knowledge of 380kV GIS/AIS substations and HV systems .
Experience in project planning, execution, monitoring, testing, commissioning, and handover.
Good understanding of GIS, transformers, protection systems, control systems, SCADA, and associated substation equipment.
Strong subcontractor and stakeholder management experience.
Good understanding of project schedules, budgets, risks, contracts, and change management.
Strong knowledge of HSE and quality requirements.
Good leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple project interfaces and work under demanding project schedules.
Experience delivering complete EPC Substation projects in Saudi Arabia or the GCC.
Experience managing projects from engineering and procurement through construction, testing, commissioning, energization, and final handover .
r: Manage the complete execution of 380kV Substation projects from project mobilization through testing, commissioning, and handover.
Lead and coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities.
Monitor installation and commissioning of major equipment including GIS, power transformers, switchgear, protection and control systems, SCADA, cables, and auxiliary systems .
Ensure project execution complies with SEC standards, approved drawings, specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable international standards .
Prepare and monitor project schedules, milestones, manpower requirements, and resource plans.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, engineering teams, and internal stakeholders.
Monitor project progress, cost, quality, safety, and overall performance.
Identify project risks, delays, technical issues, and interface challenges and ensure timely corrective actions.
Manage subcontractors and ensure their work meets project requirements, schedule, quality, and HSE standards.
Review project reports, progress updates, technical submissions, and project documentation.
Conduct regular project meetings and provide clear progress updates to senior management and clients.
Support commercial and contractual matters including variations, claims, change orders, and project correspondence.
Ensure successful testing, energization, commissioning, final documentation, and project handover.

The Duty and Compliance Manager will oversee all activities related to customs duty management, including duty exemption programs, import/export control, and customs compliance. This role ensures that goods are moved in and out of the Kingdom in compliance with local and international regulations while maximizing cost efficiency through effective duty exemption strategies.

The Duty and Compliance Manager will lead a team responsible for managing compliance activities with various local regulators, ensuring accurate documentation, liaising with government authorities, and safeguarding the organization from compliance risks. The role requires strong leadership, technical expertise in trade compliance, and excellent stakeholder management skills.
q: Strong knowledge of Saudi Customs procedures, GCC customs laws, and international trade regulations.
Expertise in duty exemption policies and their application to industrial/manufacturing projects.
Advanced knowledge of import/export control, including HS classification, valuation, and free trade agreements.
Excellent leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Strong stakeholder management with government authorities and third-party providers.
Proficiency in MS Office, ERP systems (SAP/Oracle preferred), and trade compliance tools
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, International Business, Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering or Law.
7–10 years of experience in customs and trade compliance, with at least 3 years in a managerial role.
Hands-on experience in Saudi Customs’ FASAH platform and ZATCA systems.
Knowledge of SASO/SABER and SFDA conformity programs preferred.
Professional certifications in trade compliance are a strong plus.

r: Lead and manage the company’s customs duty exemption programs, ensuring eligibility, approvals, and renewals are maintained.
Oversee submission and follow-up of duty exemption requests with governmental entities.
Monitor compliance with Saudi Arabian regulations and ensure accurate reporting for duty-exempt transactions.
Identify opportunities to optimize costs through proper duty exemption utilization.
Oversee import/export compliance operations, including HS classification, valuation, and licensing requirements.
Manage and monitor import/export licenses, permits, and special authorizations.
Ensure accurate documentation for customs clearance (invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, etc.).
Implement and enforce internal controls for import/export processes to mitigate regulatory risks.
Conduct restricted party screenings and end-use/end-user checks for controlled exports.
Ensure 100% compliance with Saudi Customs, GAZT/ZATCA, SFDA, SASO, and international trade regulations.
Develop, implement, and update policies and procedures related to duty exemption and trade compliance.
Conduct periodic internal audits and prepare for external government audits.
Investigate and report suspected violations of customs or trade regulations, ensuring corrective actions.
Maintain centralized recordkeeping for all import/export and duty exemption activities.
Lead, train, and supervise the Duty Compliance team.
Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, finance, and legal teams to ensure compliance and efficiency.
Build and maintain relationships with customs authorities, free zone authorities, and service providers.
Provide training and awareness sessions to employees on customs duty exemption and import/export controls.
